_meta.description: Citations that are unreachable AND have some lead (a sitemap-based "may have moved to" suggestion or a Wayback archive snapshot) but were NOT auto-applied -- a heuristic suggestion is not verified fact, so these need a human or a separately-reviewed pass to confirm before the underlying file is touched. County candidates (from source_link_health.json) are sorted by how many county records cite the URL, most first; facility/state candidates (from map_data_citation_health.json) follow, sorted by URL.
